notes.title: WOB 1.5
notes.content: Wob has a new look and a new movement system, much more responsive and easy to use.

notes.title: WOB 1.4
notes.content: In this version of WOB, 3 new maps have been added to the tower defense mode. We plan to soon add new weapons to the game and a new battle gameplay to the game!

notes.title: Wob 1.3
notes.content:
WOB version 1.3, a new update with significant features, has activated the new TOWER DEFENSE mode, along with many improvements to the standard game.

[h3]Changed Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tower Defense game mode has been added,
[*] along with performance improvements,
[*] new objects, and additional textures.
[*] Both 3rd and 1st person cameras have also been included.
[/list]

notes.title: WOB 1.2 - New - Gameplay Mode
notes.content:
Improvements:
[list]
[*] Correction - Menu translations.
[*] New - Menu Design.
[*] New - Gameplay Mode: (Third and first-person)
[*] Addition of new translations.
[/list]

With the new gameplay mode, it is now possible to explore the world you've built in a completely new way. More updates and features will be added to this mode in the future.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] 
[*] Added new translations
[*] Added help option
[*] Added shortcuts for opening screens
[*] Added a preview of objects and shapes before insertion
[*] Added the possibility to rotate the piece before inserting
[/list]

[b]Adjustments and Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted character limit from 3 to 10 in user creation
[*] Adjusted character limit from 6 to 15 in map creation
[*] Fixed bug that allowed selecting more than one piece insertion tool
[*] Fixed bug when scrolling within a screen that also zoomed in on the game scene
[*] Fixed player movement
[*] Standardized sizes of options in the main scene
[/list]

notes.title: Initial Version Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug fixes for the HUD in some languages like German.
[*] Added the option to delete maps in the main menu.
[*] Adjustments in German translation.
[*] HUD adjustments for different resolutions.
[/list]

notes.title: World Of Blocks Release
notes.content:
World of Blocks is finally available for purchase! WOB is a sandbox game where you build your own world using tools, shapes, textures, and objects. In WOB, you have the freedom to import your own textures into the game, giving you total freedom in the world you construct.

We also plan to keep the game regularly updated with new free content.

notes.title: World Of Blocks (WOB) - A Sandbox game
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FB_cQX33gHo;full][/previewyoutube]

We are here to announce that soon our game World Of Blocks (WOB) will be released.
An exciting construction game that offers the freedom to create anything you can imagine.

In this limitless sandbox world, you are in control, equipped with a wide variety of shapes and objects to bring your ideas to life. With World Of Blocks, your imagination knows no bounds. Create magnificent structures, landscapes, and intricate designs using a vast selection of building elements. The only limit is your creativity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44702148/b4d9ccf0a64f406b1c641731c6c3dd9a64e715ef.png[/img]

Access a rich library of shapes and objects to build your dream world.

Remember that World Of Blocks is still in development, and we will be introducing more content and features in future updates. We invite you to join us on this creative journey, where the sky's the limit, and your imagination is your greatest asset.
